senses.gloss:
शिक्य śikya, n. (V., C.) carrying sling;
 vessel 🞄or scale suspended by strings.

शिक्वन् śik-van, a. [√ 1. śak] artistic (V.);
 🞄-vas, a. [√ 1. śak] mighty (RV.).

शिक्षित śikṣita, pp. simple & cs. √ śikṣ;
 🞄n. teaching, instruction: -akṣara, a. having 🞄learnt his letters = reading and writing.

शीक् ŚĪK, Ⅰ. Ā. śīka (rare), drip, sprinkle: 🞄pp. śīkitá, having dripped (V.);
 cs. P. śīkaya, besprinkle (C.).
शीकर śīk-ara, m. (gnly. pl.) thin rain, spray: 🞄-kaṇa, m. drop.

शीकरिन् śīkar-in, a. wafting spray (wind);
 🞄squirting water (elephantʼs trunk).
